Chapter 1020: Chapter 27 Massive World-Breaking Origin Force (Added Chapter, Seeking Monthly Pass)_2

“The strongest entity of the galaxy has taken all citizens of the human civilization into his internal universe, transferring such an enormous number of lives in an instant. The cosmic backlash this would provoke is unprecedented.”

“I can feel it—the Origin Source of the universe is enraged!”

A series of Twelfth Layer ultimate beings felt their scalps go numb; the Origin Source of the universe, devoid of specific emotions, now rarely revealed its fury.

Lin Yuan’s actions had unequivocally shattered its boundaries.

Normally, after the grand obliteration of a universe, countless lives would fall alongside it and transform into nourishment, fueling the birth of the next Cosmic Era.

Yet now, with Lin Yuan transferring most of the lives away, the loss of such vast numbers would cause the cosmos to require far greater time to foster new energy—an immense detriment.

“The galaxy…”

The nine strongest beings of the human civilization simultaneously turned their gazes toward Lin Yuan, their expressions tinged with worry.

Even though they held unwavering faith in Lin Yuan, the genuine sense of rage emanating from the Origin Source left them slightly unsettled.

“Angry, huh?”

Lin Yuan also detected the ’emotion’ radiating from the cosmic Origin Source. However, he did not stop but continued transferring the life imprints of the countless citizens residing within his internal universe.

In the next moment.

The backlash descended.

A terrifying pressure cloaked everything, yet it seemed as though it dissipated into nothingness, incapable even of disturbing the hem of Lin Yuan’s garment.

In the distance, numerous Twelfth Layer alien beings were closely observing Lin Yuan’s movements, eager to witness how the strongest entity of the galaxy would withstand this wave of backlash.

“What’s going on?”

“Did the cosmic backlash truly land upon the strongest entity of the galaxy?”

“Why do I feel like he hasn’t moved an inch?”

A series of Twelfth Layer alien ultimate beings inhaled sharply, gaining a deeper understanding of the ultimate power wielded by the strongest entity of the galaxy.

“The strongest entity of the galaxy… is simply too powerful!”

Two ultimate beings of the Robber Clan exclaimed in awe. As beings at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, supported by ancestral senses, they clearly understood the magnitude of the cosmic backlash Lin Yuan was enduring.

Even masters in the Sovereign Realm would face mortal wounds when subjected to such a backlash, yet Lin Yuan remained untouched, as though nothing had occurred.

…

Beyond the universe.

Many universes had preemptively entered their grand obliteration, attracting numerous powerful beings. Outside each crumbling universe, groups of powerful entities stood guard.

Just waiting for the Twelfth Layer ultimate beings inside those universes to escape, so they could be crushed and looted.

“Following behind the Shadow Demon Great Saint and the Nine Phoenix Great Saint, I’ve already plundered eleven universes. The treasures I’ve obtained are likely worth nearly a hundred thousand Chaos Stones.”

“A hundred thousand Chaos Stones… If earned traditionally, who knows how long it might take? One Cosmic Era? Two Cosmic Eras? Now, just by waiting outside these universes, we can readily obtain them—it’s far too easy.”

“Indeed, the Twelfth Layer beings inside these universes lack combat experience. And since we hide in the shadows, they possess no means of resistance.”

…

The plunderers stationed outside the universes were chatting casually.

They occupied different regions surrounding the collapsing universes, ready to ensnare the fleeing Twelfth Layer beings the moment they escaped.

“Unfortunately, the speed of the two Great Saints is far too overwhelming, not to mention the waiting time between cosmic obliterations. Many collapsing universes have likely already been monopolized by the stronger entities ahead.”

“Why bother thinking about all that? At least the nearby few universes belong to us.”

Many plunderers lamented in frustration. If they could forever follow the two Great Saints, their rewards would likely be immeasurable—but this was far from attainable.

What level of speed do the Chaos Great Saints possess? Even in pure slaughter, they are unmatched—far beyond the grasp of Sovereign Realm beings.

Furthermore, trailing behind the Chaos Great Saints demands precision: get too close, and one risks being obliterated by the residual waves of their battles, alongside those universes.

Not even universes, whose magnitude rivals that of Chaos Venerables, could avoid premature demise under such circumstances. Sovereign Realm beings stood little chance of survival.

However, if one remained too far away, either the cosmic obliteration would end, leaving no Twelfth Layer beings to capture, or closer plunderers would take the spoils instead.

Thus, maintaining the optimal distance was crucial.

Of course, this all applied solely to plunderers of the Sovereign Realm and Path Splitting Realm.

Chaos Venerables? Chaos Venerables dared not approach the battlefields of the Great Saints.

Within the view of Chaos Great Saints, Sovereign Realm beings seemed insignificant and inconsequential; however, Chaos Venerables invariably attracted their attention.

If the Chaos Great Saints harbored even a shred of malicious intent, the Venerables’ fates would be gravely uncertain.

Chaos Venerables typically governed their own Chaos Continents, wielding a stable and abundant source of Chaos Stones, making ‘scavenging’ behind the Great Saints unnecessary.

Harvesting the remnants of a universe held little appeal for Chaos Venerables. Given the significant risks involved, they wisely weighed the costs against gains.

…

Outside the universe where Lin Yuan’s homeland resided.

A colossal black ship rapidly approached, stretching roughly a million miles long, its aura as unfathomable as an abyss. The ship’s presence projected a cold, oppressive field spanning tens of millions of light-years in radius.

Even peak Path Splitting Realm beings found themselves immobilized under the suppressive force of this field.

“This universe has also entered its grand obliteration. We’ll set up camp here.”

Standing on the ship’s prow was a towering figure over ten meters tall, his gaze indifferent, silently observing the distant universe.

The figure, named Xue You, was a renowned peak Sovereign Realm powerhouse, who had joined the ranks of plunderers targeting collapsing universes.

It couldn’t be helped; the Twelfth Layer beings within those universes were far too easy to subdue, posing virtually no risks while yielding stable treasure. Even peak Sovereign Realm beings found this irresistible.

At this moment, on the opposite side of Lin Yuan’s home universe, a massive Suspended Island spanning a million miles tore through the void to appear.

“Hahaha! So it’s Xue You Sovereign!” On the Suspended Island stood another figure: serpent-headed with a human torso, exuding an overwhelming aura as he gazed distantly at the black ship.

“Serpent Demon?” Xue You Sovereign frowned. Although the Serpent Demon Sovereign wasn’t yet at the peak of the Sovereign Realm, he was close, with peculiar methods Xue You Sovereign preferred to avoid antagonizing.

The two Sovereign Realm beings locked eyes across the void briefly, their intentions obvious—they shared the same target: the distant universe that had entered its grand obliteration.

“Xue You, how about splitting this universe between us? That area is yours, and this area is mine. What do you think?” The Serpent Demon Sovereign proposed.

Sovereign Realm beings typically avoided mutual conflict unless absolutely necessary, and the rewards of a single universe seldom justified risking their lives in a battle.

Thus, preemptive discussions for an equitable split were preferable.

“Agreed.”

Xue You Sovereign nodded.

The so-called split indicated that the Twelfth Layer beings escaping after the cosmic obliteration would belong to whoever’s designated region they entered.

Theoretically, the Twelfth Layer beings inside the universe could escape from any location.

By partitioning the regions beforehand, disputes over the escapees could be avoided.

…

On the black ship.

Xue You Sovereign gazed distantly at the collapsing universe.

“My sovereign.”

At this moment, dozens of figures appeared behind him, speaking reverently.

“You will each station yourselves within these regions.” Contemplating briefly, Xue You Sovereign assigned roles to his subordinates.

Given the sheer size of the universe, even half its area was exceedingly difficult to secure.

Even someone like Xue You Sovereign, a peak figure of unmatched caliber, couldn’t maintain vigilance across all areas all the time, necessitating the deployment of subordinates to watch for any escapees.

“Understood.”

The dozens of figures nodded before vanishing. They were all peak Path Splitting Realm beings loyal to Xue You Sovereign, serving him earnestly.

Occasionally, Xue You Sovereign would guide these subordinates or bestow them secret techniques as inheritance.

“Hopefully, the grand obliteration ends quickly.”

Xue You Sovereign silently contemplated. He intended to move on to the next collapsing universe soon.

Throughout, he never regarded the Twelfth Layer beings within the universe as worthy opponents.

To him, these Twelfth Layer beings, nurtured in the comforting embrace of their universe, weren’t even comparable to his battle-hardened subordinates.

In Xue You Sovereign’s eyes, the Twelfth Layer beings within these universes were merely living Chaos Stones, whose greatest purpose was to become the sustenance fueling his path of cultivation.

To serve as sustenance for his advancement was their honor.
